title: Fold a quad-fold game board up in its one working order and lay it in its box on the insert
instruction: Fold the game board and put it in its box.
context: Putting a board game away ends with folding the board. A quad-fold board's face paper is cut at each hinge, so every hinge only folds face-in. The long crease has two hinges; the short crease has one hinge and a cut. So it closes flat in one order only: both far quarters over first, then the stacked half over the other. Fold the short crease first and the long one would have to bend backwards. The 25 cm stack then fits the box with 7.5 mm per side.
setup: Table (cm from arm-base midpoint, x forward, y left; arms at (0, +-30.5)). Lipper 16 in (40.6 cm) bamboo lazy susan (2 cm deck on 1.2 cm bearing base, 3.2 cm tall, 1.2 kg) at (30, 2). Centred face up: 50x50 cm quad-fold board, four 25x25 cm x 2.2 mm greyboard quarters (90 g each), back-wrap hinges, cut face: long crease x 30 (2 hinges); short y 2 (near hinge, 2.5 mm far slit). Red greyboard box (27.5x27.5x5.5 cm, 5 mm walls, 250 g; glued 26.4x26.4x4 cm card insert, 4.3 cm up) at (30, -44).
scoring: Highest tier met (not additive). 0 if ever: a board quarter, turntable deck or box falls off table (>2 cm below top) or a hinge bends face-out >20 deg; or at end neither far hinge >=170 deg. End: 0.15 one far hinge >=170 deg; 0.30 both; 0.50 all 3 hinges >=170 deg (25 cm stack); 0.75 stack flat (<=10 deg) on insert in upright (<=10 deg) table-resting box (<=5 mm), grippers released and >=1 cm clear; 1.0 also grippers >=10 cm clear and <2 cm/s for final 0.5 s. Video, overhead photo, ruler.
reset_notes: Return both arms to READY. Set the lazy susan on its mark at (30, 2) and the red box base square at (30, -44). Unfold the board flat (0 deg) face up, centred on the lazy susan with the long crease along y at x 30 and the 2.5 mm slit on the far (+x) side along x at y 2.
fidelity: 240 Hz PhysX, 20 Hz control. Quarters are rigid 2.2 mm plates; hinges fold face-in 0-180 deg (-2 deg back-stop; 0.003 N m s/deg drag, 0.3 N m cap). Lazy susan deck is a revolute z-joint (0.004 N m s/deg drag) on a fixed base. Box and flat insert are rigid cuboids (wells omitted). Bounded pinch-weld hack (peels on >4.5 cm wrist-stall jam): binds only the 1-2 outer quarters directly contacted by tip_left and tip_right (>=0.5 N each, >=1 mm inside edge); inner layers stay un-welded.
